text: Hey, I’ve been trying to figure out what I want to do after graduation. What about you? Do you have any ideas yet? Yeah, I’ve always wanted to be a translator. I think it would be really interesting to translate important documents and speeches. Yeah, that sounds like a great career! What do you have to do to become a translator? Well, first of all, you have to be fluent in at least two languages. That’s not a problem for me. I’m fluent in English and German. Yeah, me, too. But you also have to have a lot of cultural knowledge so that your translations reflect any idiomatic expressions or slang. Hmm, that’s true. I didn’t think about that. But I guess that makes sense, since you can’t effectively learn a language without knowing about the cultures associated with it. Yeah, it’s a lot to consider. You have to take classes on linguistics and grammar, as well as literature and culture courses. Wow, that sounds like a lot of work! But it seems like you’re passionate about it, so I’m excited to see what opportunities open up for you. Thanks! Keep me posted on what you decide to do as well!
